feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 June 2026 10:39pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 09 June 2026 at 10:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of the British Isles as a trough continues to clear the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing West 3 or 4 later tonight or at first tomorrow morning. Backing West or Southwest 3 or 4 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming more frequent for a time tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, backing and increasing South or Southwest 5 or 6 overnight and at first on Thursday morning, veering West 5 or 6 later in the morning or early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then, rain and drizzle developing, turning patchy later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.
